requirement.original: 顶部栏的happy logo和头像元素没有自适应窗口内容元素的伸缩（位置hardcoded）；没有自适应的另外一个案例。Applies across viewport widths (wide desktop, narrow desktop, tablet, mobile) and the entire range of content-panel resizings supported (sidebar collapse/expand, split view, inspector toggle). This is spec §5.4 (paired with §5.5 as a second verification case — same fix must cover both).
requirement.clarified: The header content row (logo → center → avatar) uses a static maxWidth from layout.headerMaxWidth. This value is computed once at module load and does not update when the right sidebar (450 px) opens or the left drawer resizes. Fix: compute header maxWidth dynamically as windowWidth − leftDrawerWidth − rightSidebarOpenWidth, applied via useWindowDimensions + useRightSidebar at render time. Both Header.tsx and ChatHeaderView.tsx must be fixed (§5.4 + §5.5 respectively).
requirement.what: Make header content row maxWidth a live reactive function of available main-area width
requirement.why: Static layout.headerMaxWidth does not account for RightSidebar (450 px fixed) or left drawer state changes, causing logo/avatar to appear misaligned when sidebars open/close

included: Right-sidebar open/close state read via useRightSidebar
Left-drawer width read via windowWidth formula mirroring SidebarNavigator.tsx:21-24
excluded: Content list, input area, or any layout below the header

success_criteria: Header content row shrinks by 450 px when right sidebar opens on desktop (≥901 px viewport)
Header content row restores full main-area width when right sidebar closes
Header content row expands when left drawer collapses
Mobile layout (< 901 px) unchanged — no width subtraction when sidebar is modal
ChatHeaderView behaves identically to Header.tsx under same conditions
constraints: Must use useWindowDimensions() at render time — cannot rely on Dimensions.get at module load
Unistyles StyleSheet.create runs once; dynamic maxWidth must be applied as inline style override
Preserve Mac behaviour: no fixed cap on Mac (Infinity effectively), but sidebar widths still subtracted
DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH = 901 is the threshold below which right sidebar is a modal (no subtraction)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Happy logo and avatar do not reflow when right sidebar opens or left drawer collapses — they appear offset relative to the content column
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: layout.headerMaxWidth is a static constant evaluated at module-load time (before any window resize or sidebar events). It does not react to RightSidebar.isOpen changes or window width changes. Both Header.tsx:215 and ChatHeaderView.tsx:221 apply this static value as maxWidth.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 7f178466 — fix: fix monorepo (initial commit, layout.ts introduced with static getMaxWidth())
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: layout.ts was written as a simple static helper providing a size cap. At the time of authoring, the RightSidebar did not exist or was not considered. The static approach works when there is no variable right panel.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Once RightSidebar was added (fixed 450 px, desktop only), the header's content column no longer knows the sidebar exists. The maxWidth stays at 800 or Infinity while the sidebar steals 450 px of layout width, producing the visible misalignment.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Static layout.ts present since initial commit (2026-01-27). RightSidebar introduced by commit 20380c75 (2026-04-07, 'fix: sidebar polish — detail/sidebar coexist, header offset, section icons, cleanup'). The misalignment has existed since that commit.
observations: layout.ts:43 exports headerMaxWidth = getMaxWidth() — called at module load, returns 800 on web/tablet or Infinity on Mac (inferred: Read of layout.ts)
Header.tsx:215 applies maxWidth: layout.headerMaxWidth in StyleSheet.create (static) (inferred: Read of Header.tsx)
ChatHeaderView.tsx:221 applies maxWidth: layout.headerMaxWidth in StyleSheet.create (static) (inferred: Read of ChatHeaderView.tsx)
RightSidebar.tsx:11 SIDEBAR_WIDTH = 450, DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH = 901 (inferred: Read of RightSidebar.tsx)
rightSidebarStore.ts isOpen boolean controls desktop panel visibility (inferred: Read of rightSidebarStore.ts)
SidebarNavigator.tsx:21-24 drawerWidth = min(max(floor(windowWidth*0.3), 250), 360) — already dynamic (inferred: Read of SidebarNavigator.tsx)
root_cause_analysis.diagnosis_completeness: incomplete (inferred only — runtime Playwright verification not performed; layout misalignment is a deterministic consequence of static maxWidth vs dynamic panel widths)
root_cause_analysis.localization_evidence: layout.ts:6-21 getMaxWidth() uses Dimensions.get at call time (module load). There is no useWindowDimensions hook or event listener. Header.tsx:215 passes this static value to StyleSheet.create. RightSidebar.tsx:137 applies width: SIDEBAR_WIDTH to the desktop panel container. There is no code anywhere that notifies the header of sidebar open/close.

git_bisect_result.commit_message: fix: sidebar polish — detail/sidebar coexist, header offset, section icons, cleanup
git_bisect_result.bisect_blocked: Not a regression in the classical sense — layout.ts static approach was always limited; the RightSidebar introduction at 20380c75 is when the mismatch became visible
